1. This file is COMPLETELY SELF-CONTAINED
   - All CSS styles are embedded in <style> tag

2. OFFLINE CAPABILITY
   - Can be opened directly from file:// protocol
   - Works without internet connection
   - Works without web server

3. BROWSER COMPATIBILITY
   - Tested: Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, Edge 90+
   - Uses vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)
   - No framework dependencies
   - Should work in browsers for 10+ years

4. FILE INTEGRITY
   - Original size: ~100KB
   - Do NOT minify or compress further
   - Do NOT strip comments from embedded JSON
   - Keep as single file - do NOT split

5. HOSTING RECOMMENDATIONS
   - Serve with: Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
   - Cache headers: Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable
   - HTTPS recommended but not required
   - No server-side processing needed

6. MAINTENANCE
